scope.summary: Implement text wrap as a per-object property, enumerable by wrap shape: None (no displacement), Bounding box/Square (rectangular bounds), Object shape/Tight/Contour (follows a contour source: object edges, alpha channel, embedded clipping path, or frame), Jump object (text jumps below within the column), Jump to next column (text jumps to next column/frame). Wrap MUST support per-side offsets (top/bottom/left/right), invert, wrap-to side selection (both, left, right, largest area, toward/away from spine), include-inside-edges, and an independently editable wrap outline distinct from the object geometry. Contour source shared with clipping/masking (MT-162).
acceptance_criteria: all wrap modes + contour sources + offsets/invert/side/inside-edges + independent editable wrap outline
expected_tests: live: each wrap mode displaces text as specified incl contour from edges/alpha/clip-path/frame
test: per-side offsets, invert, wrap-to-side, include-inside-edges, editable wrap outline distinct from geometry

risk_if_missed: No text wrap around objects; image/text composition impossible.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
